article.title: Key takeaways from this week's political meeting in Beijing
article.summary: The Communist party central committee meeting was focused on discipline and fighting corruption. It comes ahead of next year when Xi is widely expected to try to secure a fourth term. (Image credit: Ng Han Guan)
